paper_title: Constraining the axion-photon coupling using radio data of the Bullet Cluster
notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling g_agamma using radio observations of the Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-55.8) at frequencies 1.1-3.1 GHz. Data points extracted from Table 2 (2σ upper limits for two-component model with cosmic-ray background). Mass values converted from µeV to eV (e.g., 14-17 µeV → 1.4e-5 to 1.7e-5 eV; central values used: 15.5, 18.5, 21.5, 24.5, 27.5, 30.5 µeV). The paper reports best-fit g_agamma ≈ 2.4×10^-11 GeV^-1 at m_a ≈ 15.3 µeV (4.2σ significance) and conservative upper limits of (2.3-5.3)×10^-11 GeV^-1. The tighter two-component model limits (including cosmic-ray contribution) range from ~10^-12 to 10^-11 GeV^-1 across the mass range 14-32 µeV, tighter than CAST but comparable to IAXO/ALPS-IIc projections. This is an astrophysical/observational constraint (not a haloscope), so no local DM density is assumed. Confidence level set to 0.95 reflecting 2σ statistical significance in the analysis. | selector: table (sole candidate)
